profile.headline:
Consultant/Lead Front-End UI Engineer /Scrum Master at Avanade AI.

I turn design into shipped product under real constraints.
profile.summary:
As a Consultant - Full Stack Developer and Certified Scrum Master at Avanade, I lead teams in building responsive UIs using React.js, TypeScript, Redux, JavaScript, Agentic AI, Orchestrators, Claude, GitHub Copilot, HTML5, CSS3, and other web technologies. I hold a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science from UCI and a State of California Certification of Expertise in C++ Programming. My experience spans full stack development, working with various platforms, frameworks, and databases.

With extensive experience in Agile methodologies, I have successfully led teams in delivering high-quality applications, enhancing usability for non-technical users, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. My expertise in Scrum and advanced Agile practices, combined with a proven track record of mentoring and coaching teams, positions them as a valuable asset in driving effective software development and collaboration.

My experience also includes using Azure DevOps, Microsoft Power Platform, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Canvas App, Jira, and Figma for web development and usability design. I am fluent in English, Spanish, and Catalan, and have completed several online courses and certifications in React.js. I am passionate about creating user-friendly and accessible web interfaces that meet the needs and expectations of clients and users.

positions.title: Consultant - Full Stack Developer - Scrum Master
positions.description:
As a Consultant - Full Stack Developer and Certified Scrum Master at Avanade, I lead teams in designing, managing, and building responsive UIs using Test Driven Development, React.js, TypeScript, Redux, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, JEST, Node.js, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft Canvas App, Usability Design, Scrum, and Figma. I have successfully designed, built, and tested web-based and Agentic AI applications, and edited site content using content management systems (CMS), ensuring high standards and compliance with predefined design guidelines. By applying Agile/Scrum methodologies, I have streamlined web application development processes, resulting in increased efficiency and reduced costs. I have created and managed web pages, added/edited content, and uploaded/removed documents using CMS, maintaining website standards and utilizing best practices in web design to source and update data through web screens as specified in functional requirements. Additionally, I have selected and interviewed software developers for web application development, coaching and mentoring them on responsiveness, accessibility, and Scrum methodologies. Leveraging AI tools like GitHub Copilot and Builder.io, I have significantly improved output and efficiency in the development of web applications.

Key Achievements:

Led the development of multiple high-quality, responsive web applications, enhancing user experience and accessibility.
Designed and implemented complex React/TypeScript/Next.js solutions, enhancing platform capabilities for non-technical users.

Implemented Agile/Scrum methodologies, resulting in significant increases in project delivery speed.
Owned architectural refactors that reduced technical debt, enabling more efficient feature development
Utilized AI tools to automate coding processes, reducing development time.
Successfully mentored and coached developers, improving team performance and collaboration.

positions.title: Senior Analyst, Full-Stack Developer
positions.description: Build Responsive UIs using React.JS, Redux, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Node.JS, Azure DevOps, Usability Design, Scrum and Figma. Build and test web-based application and edit site content for various components using content management system (CMS).Create and manage web pages, add/edit content and upload/remove documents using CMS. Maintain website standards and comply with predefined design guidelines.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Creating Full-Stack applications for NodeRun using JavaScript, Node.js, React.js, MariaDB, SQL, HTML5, CSS3, Profound.js and Profound UI. Writing documentation and shooting and editing tutorial videos for NodeRun applications. Preparing and presenting NodeRun demos. Maintenance, updates and new pages and posts in WordPress company site.
